facts.fact: The Vision 2030 Delivery Secretariat's desk review of all 47 counties says Murang'a, Nairobi City, Machakos, Laikipia and Nyeri scored full or near-full on revenue-system reliability, showing well-established ERP systems and cashless revenue collection.
The report says six of 47 counties (Grade D, scores under 40%) rely heavily on manual and cash-based systems.

note: The held .txt was read; the report scores counties from websites and Controller of Budget reports and does not name products or give a register of payers.
